svg.title: Reset commands and their scope
svg.desc: The five current Reset commands. Each description distinguishes what is removed or restored from what remains. Command guide illustration, not a screenshot. No live user data.
svg.metadata: Source: addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.xml; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/Ribbon/LokalRibbon.cs; addin/LOKAL.PowerPoint/LOKAL.PowerPoint.csproj; assets/*.png. Authored as a code-native SVG command guide. Existing PNG icons embedded without external image references. Commands using Office imageMso icons are represented by a plain Office label, not a substitute icon.
svg.text: Command guide · illustration, not a screenshot
